# Process Street

Process Street supports creating and running checklists, SOPs, and workflows, helping teams automate recurring processes and track compliance

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/process-street/.

## Actions

- **Complete a workflow run**: This tool marks an entire workflow run as completed in process street.
- **Create Workflow Run**: This tool creates a new workflow run from a specified workflow template.
- **Find Data Set Rows** (read-only): This tool allows you to search for records within a data set based on form fields.
- **List Workflows** (read-only): This tool retrieves a list of all workflows available in the process street account.
- **Undelete Workflow Run**: This tool allows you to restore a previously deleted workflow run in process street.
